title: TherianCraft
description: This is an official Modpack for the new TherianCraft server with amazing mods & features!
body:
# Overview
This is an official Modpack for the TherianCraft server, featuring various Cobblemon side mods and additional side mods to add various server features! Come and experience the fun on TherianCraft today!

# Features
- 8 gyms, an Elite Four, and Champion!

Take on 8 Player-Run gyms, an Elite Four, and GreekGodGaming as the champion to become the very best like no one ever was!

- Custom Biomes

Adventure into a wilderness full of customly generated biomes that you wouldn't see in a vanilla world!

- WonderTrade

If you are familiar with games like Pokémon X/Y or Pokémon Omega Ruby/Alpha Sapphire, you would know what this is!

- In-Game Shop & Economy

Sell & buy various goods like ores, ingots, held items, and more to the in-game shop for in-game money!

- Mega Evolution

Mega Evolution has come to the TherianCraft server! Now, you can mega-evolve your Pokémon for competitive battling!

- Daycare

Breed multiple Pokémon at a time in multiple pens to make eggs and IV train your Pokémon!

- EV Training Area

EV Train your Pokémon to their stats for competitive battling!

- Level Grinding Area

Level up your Pokémon fast by battling wild Pokémon that give you boosted experience!

- GTS (Global Trading System)

Sell Pokémon and items to other players across the server for in-game money with a simple command!

- For a full list of features, join the Discord server, or warp to the server features on the TherianCraft server!
